company.name: MIS
company.shortDescription: MIS is a full range of IT solutions aligning with global IT partners.
company.description:
Established in 1979 with headquarters in Riyadh and branches in Jeddah and Al-Khobar, Al Moammar Information Systems Co. is a closed Joint Stock Saudi Company that provides IT system integration solutions of incomparable quality and outstanding value.
From old legacy systems to cloud computing, they evolved to stay abreast of IT trends and build a diversified ecosystem that puts our clients strategically ahead of their competition. 

MIS has achieved the highest Saudi Government Classification Certificate which is a prerequisite to be able to bid and execute large scale IT projects and services in the kingdom reflecting its credibility in the market 

They have a dedicated Project Management Office that ensures on-time delivery for more than 300 customers on different verticals. Our key differentiator what sets us apart from other IT integrators comes from a combination of efficient operations with a high level of project control as well as exceptional local and cultural knowledge. In addition, they have instilled a culture that promotes an outstanding work ethic. Our human capital is our most important asset they have top-notch IT systems engineers, dedicated pre-sales engineers, and account managers who see our clients through every step of the process. 

Our vision, which they are well on our way to fulfill, is to be premiere provider of diversified IT business in the Saudi Arabia market. Our strategy of parallel diversification and specialization in a broad range of verticals satisfies the IT needs of companies from a variety of market sectors. 

They guard our clients’ information and know that a long-term partnership is contingent upon our ability to maintain high standards of ethics, professionalism, and integrity. Our reputation is what they hold most dear and our clients can trust us with their most vital data and most significant projects.
